card.name: Linking words after dose amounts
card.fires_on: The word 'of' (or a unit like mg or units) right after a dose amount such as 14 mcg or 150 mcg, just before a drug or vitamin name. Also some spots inside supplement and hormone names.

modes.label: 'of' after amount
modes.description: The word 'of' directly after a number and unit, before the named drug.
modes.example: contains 1 mcg<< of>> epinephrine. Correct blood volume

modes.label: Unit inside vitamin dose
modes.description: A unit word or mg that sits between a number and a vitamin or fluoride name.
modes.example: alendronate/2800 international units vitamin D 3 or 70 mg alendronate/5600 international<< units>> vitamin D 3 tablet once weekly.

modes.label: Inside supplement or hormone names
modes.description: Partway through names like cholecalciferol or liothyronine.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens (oil, essential, fat) suggest it steers away from oil and supplement-type words after the amount.
card.plain: It marks the small word between a dose amount and the name of the drug or vitamin.
